g.text: FlareRank1Convo1 begins.
hey, space traveler
Oh, hi. Flare, right?
Hey. What's up?
you're the one the other science experiments have been telling me about, right?
sitting here with nothing better to do. i have a bunch of questions for you, if you've got time
I'd say I can't imagine there'd be two of me around here, but. Well. Long story. Anyway.
Depends on what they've been saying. But probably.
Nothing better to do, so you decided to come tap on the glass of the zoo. Nice.
Really? Nothing better to do? I'm flattered. lol.
If you'd like to ask questions, I'm here. Ask away.
right. well. they filled me in on the basics.
sure...
+5 Chemistry
heh, sorry. came off wrong.
great
amir had... details to provide, shall we say. quite quickly.
Have you come to tap on the glass of the zoo?
How can I help you?
oh, sol, never. sorry to give that impression. though i suppose you're right. we protoframes aren't the only science experiments in town, are we?
the infestation. this rot. this thing that's poisoning my blood. i need to know everything you know
very... very quickly...
+5 Chemistry
Could be worse.
Just something you learn to live with over time, I guess.
Nope.
starting at the top. if you could. kindly. *now.*
Check boolean QuincySpaceTrauma
oh, sol, never. sorry to give that impression. though i suppose you're right. we protoframes aren't the only experiments in town, are we?
i would *love* to know how exactly you think it could get worse than this
that's what i wanted to talk to you about, actually...
so tell me
Update boolean FlareInfestation1
and the other one had something to say about "space trauma" i believe?
true
Lol. Well, at least we can skip the introductory stuff.
false
enlighten me
where did he go? entrati? the others claim they don't know. that you don't either
I'm not sure I like your attitude?
Uh... That's going to take a while, and I don't think it's going to give you the answers you want.
Whoa, hold on. Back up. Are you okay?
Yep. That'd be Quincy.
because from where i stand, i have a poison in my blood that is slowly causing me to lose my mind and corrupting my body
i call bullshit
i... apologize. this is not usually how i like to act. however, i'm in a bit of a situation that is... very hard to describe
this isn't about me wanting answers, dear space traveler. this is about me *needing* answers
i don't think i can adequately put into words how very not okay i am
and the only man who could give me answers about it - the only man who could explain it to me or get rid of her is *gone*
so i'd like to know everything you know about him, if you don't mind
and i'll remind you that is literally my job to put my feelings into words
and I don't think i can adequately put into words how very different my situation is from the others and how I *need* to get rid of her *immediately*
Update boolean FlareInfestation1
starting at the top
so i'll simply lay it out on the table as this. i made a mistake, taking this bizarre injection
Her?
What you're going through is no different than what the Hex went through. You're not alone.
I understand what you're going through. I can help you.
I know what's happened is terrifying - becoming a protoframe, the situation here in Höllvania -
I meant that there are worse things in the world than being seen as a freak. Yikes.
i don't know what help you need, what bribing, what favors i need to do for you - but i *need* to get rid of her *now*
Who's "her?"
no. no i don't think it is at all the same. i'm starting to think that you don't understand... and *that's* what scares me
that's just it. i'm starting to think that you don't understand... and *that's* what scares me
that's just it. i'm starting to think that you don't understand... and *that's* what scares me
+5 Chemistry
Update boolean FlareLizzie1
You're going to be okay. I promise.
Suit yourself. I'll be here when you want to talk.
Then help me understand, Flare. Talk to me. What's going on?
while i... appreciate that sentiment, this transcends any level social nonconformity and into something entirely different
Flare?
i wish i believed you
+20 Chemistry
i... can't. i'm sorry. i just can't...
something i cannot find words to describe, and that is my job - to put feelings into words
+20 Chemistry
+20 Chemistry
